tokens.name: port-orange
tokens.usage: Brand colour: the P bowl in the mark, primary buttons, the live/play accent. As text only at 24px+ on surface-100 (3.4:1); fine for any size as a fill behind white or ink-on-orange labels at 18px+.

tokens.name: harbour-ink
tokens.usage: Brand deep navy: the mark's tile, app header bar. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Brand off-white: letters of the mark on harbour-ink or port-orange. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: signal-teal
tokens.usage: Secondary accent: success, published, 'ready' states and links on surface-100 (4.9:1 light). Use sparingly next to port-orange.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and inputs on surface-100.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, timestamps on surface-100/200 (≥4.5:1 both themes).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase tags such as LIVE, DRAFT.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; clear space around the mark = 1/4 of its height.

tokens.name: radius-mark
tokens.usage: The mark's tile corner at 120px (23% of its side); app icons and avatars echo it.
